method: Compute the maximum close-axis projection over yaw_offset plus or minus the target yaw error bound, add max(10 percent of width, 3 mm), invert the measured CAL-026 gap table, and quantize upward to 0.01 percent.

fit_correction.obsolete_behavior: Use only nominal yaw and round percentage to nearest 0.01 percent.
fit_correction.corrected_behavior: Maximize width over the full yaw-error band and round percentage upward.
fit_correction.regression_test: test_grasp预张开度覆盖偏航误差包络并向上量化

limitations: CAL-039 has no supplied dimensional measurement resolution and combines axiswise maxima from 17 demo samples.
CAL-026 used one measurement per opening and omitted reverse-direction repeats for the demo.
